# ml_namd key pinned dependencies (training, genA, ML-TSH, harvest, analysis).

# IMPORTANT ordering (see ../docs/installation_and_environment.md):
#   1) create a clean Python 3.13.5 environment,
#   2) install the CUDA 11.8 PyTorch wheel FIRST (NOT listed here, to avoid a CPU-wheel downgrade):
#        pip install torch==2.7.1+cu118 --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu118
#   3) pip install -r requirements.txt   (this file),
#   4) install HIPPYNN and PySEQM editable at their pinned commits (see the install guide).
#
# Versions below are the pins the pipeline was validated with. HIPPYNN (commit d260cd5) and
# PySEQM (commit e273f6d) are installed editable from source, not from PyPI.
